lines.text: Because of the LORD's loving devotion we are not consumed, and His mercies are new every morning.
His soul calls the LORD his fortress, and the LORD is good to those who wait for Him.
A man should bear the yoke while young, sit alone in silence because the LORD laid it on him.
The Lord will not cast us off forever, and even if He causes grief, He will show anger.
The Lord does not approve of crushing prisoners or denying justice, and adversity and good come from the Most High.
